title: Add conditional operator sentinels and residency-proof translator for KMS region controls
author: Nina Park
release_notes: Adds conditional operator sentinels and a translator service that validates and pins KMS region claims for tenant-scoped requests. Backwards compatible; opt-in via feature flag 'residency.sentinel.enabled'.
body:
Context and motivation: Customer audits revealed intermittent cases where operator-scoped requests could route to a KMS in a different region when a fallback path was exercised during transient capacity shortages. This PR implements a lightweight runtime safety layer (operator sentinels) and a small translator/validator that canonicalizes residency claims into KMS-region proofs before key allocation. Goal is to reduce cross-region key churn and provide deterministic enforcement for tenant region-pin policies while keeping existing routing fallbacks intact behind a feature flag.

Summary of changes: single continuous description string summarizing multiple components: 1) runtime: add OperatorSentinel middleware (serving/runtime/middleware/sentinel.go) that intercepts operator tokens and enforces conditional region assertions before KMS calls; 2) policy: extend RBACv2 policy model with 'region_assertion' clause and evaluator hooks (policy/ast/region_assertion.go and policy/evaluator/region_assertion_test.go); 3) translator service: introduce residency-proof-translator (tools/residency-translator/) — a small binary that turns tenant region hints and operator claims into signed translator proofs consumed by the KMS allocator; 4) KMS integration: plumb proof check into kms/allocator/allocator.go and add unit tests and integration shim for local testing; 5) docs & config: console flags, upgrade notes and a quickstart snippet for testers (docs/security/residency-sentinels.md).

Checklist: - [x] Add middleware and translator binary; - [x] Unit tests for policy evaluator and middleware; - [x] Integration test which simulates fallback routing and verifies translator proof is respected; - [x] Feature flag gating and migration plan; - [x] Console and operator docs + release note entry.

Commits (high-level): - 1a2b3c4: add OperatorSentinel middleware and basic tests - 2b3c4d5: introduce region_assertion field in RBACv2 schema + evaluator - 3c4d5e6: initial residency-proof-translator binary, signer + local fake KMS adapter - 4d5e6f7: integrate proof checks in kms allocator, add integration test harness - 5e6f7g8: docs, feature flag wiring, and e2e test adjustments

Files changed (representative): - serving/runtime/middleware/sentinel.go (new) - policy/ast/region_assertion.go (new) - policy/evaluator/region_assertion_test.go (new) - tools/residency-translator/main.go (new) - tools/residency-translator/README.md (new) - kms/allocator/allocator.go (modified) - docs/security/residency-sentinels.md (new) - config/flags.yaml (modified) - test/integration/residency-fallback-test.go (new)

Small illustrative snippets included in changed files: - OperatorSentinel checks token.claims["operator_scope"] and token.claims["tenant_region"] and rejects KMS allocate calls when translator proof missing unless feature flag disabled. - Translator signs a JSON blob {tenant_id, requested_region, timestamp, nonce} with a translator key and returns base64(signature)+payload. KMS allocator verifies using translator public key.

Review conversation (selected highlights): - Alexei Voronin (reviewer): "Nice separation between sentinel and translator. Two asks: 1) can the translator accept multiple region hints in the payload to support staged migrations? 2) add a smoke test that exercises translator key rotation." - Nina Park (author): "Addressed both: translator now accepts an array 'region_candidates' and rotation smoke test added in tools/residency-translator/rotation_test.go; added notes in docs about rotation cadence." - Priya Desai (reviewer): "Policy grammar change looks good. Please ensure older RBAC policy files lacking region_assertion are treated as 'no assertion' (deny-by-default for operator flows)." - Nina Park: "Policy deserialization defaults region_assertion to 'none' and the middleware treats 'none' as permissive only for non-operator tokens. Added unit test to assert behavior." - Marcus Lee (SRE reviewer): "CI failure on e2e flake during fallback simulation. Observed intermittent 502 from fake-kms; added retry and deterministic backoff in the test harness." - Nina Park: "Fixed; re-ran CI and confirmed stability."

CI summary: - unit-tests: pass - lint: pass - integration/residency-fallback: initially failed (flake) then pass after test harness stabilization - security-scan: pass (no new high/critical findings) - e2e: pass

Migration and rollout plan: - Deploy translator as an opt-in component in staging behind 'residency.sentinel.enabled=false' - Nightly runs for two weeks with translator in 'audit-only' mode to collect mismatches (translator produces proofs but allocator runs in audit-only and logs mismatches) - Flip to enforcement for a subset of tenants (canary) using tenant tag 'residency.canary=true' - Full rollout if canary shows <0.1% blocked operator flows within 72 hours; fallback policy remains to route to default KMS only when explicit consent header present and feature flag permits.

Observability & telemetry added: - meter/residency.proofs.generated counter - meter/residency.proofs.rejected counter - trace spans for translator->allocator handshake with 200ms default timeout metric - debug log path to dump translator payloads when audit-only mode enabled

Security considerations: translator private key is stored in secret-store with lifecycle policy; added a short-term shape key rotation test and an access control checklist for deployment. The RBACv2 policy change is additive and default-safe for existing policies.

Merge outcome: Squash-merged after approvals from Alexei, Priya and Marcus. Changelog entry included and release notes staged for the next security patch release.

Related work: ENG-2201 (region-pin telemetry), ENG-2456 (rbacv2 policy extensibility), SUP-1209 (customer audit ticket).
